sentences.en: Mr. Flynt and his associates made normalizing taboos their business.
sentences.zh: 弗林特先生和他的伙伴们把打破禁忌当作他们的生意。

sentences.en: That subject is taboo. We do not speak about it.
sentences.zh: 那个话题是禁忌，我们不谈论它。

sentences.en: Incest is a taboo found in almost all cultures.
sentences.zh: 乱伦在几乎所有文化中都是一个禁忌。
